agyos_skill.instructions: The **Pinterest platform engine** — search-first mechanics, fresh vertical pins, keyword/SEO, and outbound traffic that compounds. The agent drafts pins + SEO copy + schedule; the image skills produce the designs; **scheduling-and-queue → WoopSocial** publishes the pins. Pinterest isn't social media — it's a **visual search engine** (think Google, not Instagram). Users arrive **with intent**, discovery is **keyword-driven not follower-driven**, and **pins are evergreen** (months–years), so today's work keeps paying for **years**. Optimise for **discoverability + outbound clicks**, not in-the-moment engagement. The levers: **keyword SEO**, **fresh distinct pin designs**, the **2:3 format**, and — uniquely among the majors — **linking out** (Pinterest *wants* to send you traffic). It's a **long game (3–6 months to traction)**. Best for **visual/product/lifestyle/ e-commerce/blog-traffic** brands. 1. **brand-profile** — look, palette, audience, non-negotiables. 2. **voice-builder** — so pin titles/descriptions sound like the brand. (Depth: `references/the-pins-framework.md`.) - **P — Position for search:** keyword research first (Pinterest Trends/autocomplete; long-tail, semantic); keywords in title/description/board/alt/filename; boards as keyword-themed clusters. (The keyword-research + title/description craft → `pinterest-seo`.) - **I — Images that stop + signal:** vertical **2:3 (1000×1500)** (other ratios penalized) + keyword text overlay; static for traffic, video (9:16, 6–15s) for engagement; the pin's visual craft → `pinterest-pin-design` (rendered via the image skills). - **N — New designs, consistently:** fresh is the #1 rule — **3–5 distinct designs per destination** (not repins); 3–10/day steady; **space ~72h between pins to the same URL**. - **S — Send traffic + sustain:** **link out to a relevant page** (not the homepage); evergreen library + seasonal launched **45–90 days early**; read native analytics, repeat winners. Search-not-social; fresh pins #1 (~90% of traffic; saves now minimal); keywords top factor (hashtags ~1% — dead); 2:3 mandatory; link-out rewarded; 72h same-URL rule; seasonal lead times; fit + GenAI
